messages:
sam: EdgeWave raised a reconciliation issue — they claim a set of retroactive entitlements for Jun	Aug weren't billed. partner says ~3.2k units missing. can partnerships + billing triage?
priya: ack. do we have a sample event id or a partner CSV to start with?
sam: they sent a sample event: ew-evt-20250614-9f3b, partner timestamp 1713500400. attached summary from them: 'partner: EdgeWave, period: 2025-06 to 2025-08, claimed_units: 3200, invoiced_by_redwood: 0'.
marketplace-bot: Export ready: s3://marketplace-exports/edgewave/2025-08/usage_export_20250831.json (sha256: e3b0c44...).
james: quick note: historically timezone/windowing shifts cause hourly events near midnight to be attributed to previous day and dropped by our dedupe. i'll check mapping (EW-HW-100 vs our EW-HARDWARE-100).
priya: plan: 1) validate marketplace export row counts 2) join export -> raw_ingest to see which partner ids are present 3) identify records ingested but filtered (sku mismatch, policy filters) 4) prepare unmatched CSV to share with partner/finance.
derek: i'll run a staging replay dry-run: `./tools/replay_ingest --partner edgewave --from 2025-06-01 --to 2025-08-31 --dry-run` and post the diff. won't do a real replay until we have signoff.
nana: typo 94 i'm ana from legal 94 question: if we owe retro credits, is that negative invoice line or credit memo? contract clause might cap backdated credits to 90 days. need to confirm before committing.
maria-finance: finance preference is credit memo, but we need documented evidence (device telemetry / partner proof) for anything outside standard credit policy.
priya: grabbing marketplace export now and will run checksum + counts against our hourly rollups. will produce unmatched CSV if any.
marketplace-bot: Reconciliation summary: 2025-09-04 15:12 UTC 94 partner rows: 3,200; matched to redwood: 2,805; unmatched: 395. Details: https://internal.apps/redwood-recon/edgewave/2025-Q3
sam: partner claims 3.2k missing, but recon shows 395 unmatched. need to reconcile methodology differences. can we get raw unmatched ids CSV?
priya: generating CSV now and will cross-check with raw_ingest. if raw_ingest has them but they were filtered, we'll capture reason codes (sku_mismatch, window_drop, policy_filter).
james: will audit `infra/partner_mappings/edgewave.yml` and push a small mapping fix + unit test if I find a discrepancy.
derek: replay dry-run done 94 looks like ~380 records would be accepted after remap. uploaded diff: s3://redwood-temp/edgewave/replay-diff-3276543210.json
ana: legal note: contract 4.2 caps retro credits at 90 days unless partner can provide inbound device delivery proofs. if events are older than 90 days from invoice run, we may decline a credit and propose an alternative (one-time goodwill credit).
maria-finance: confirmed. finance will not approve negative revenue adjustments beyond policy without legal signoff.
sam: action items: sam -> lead partner comms; priya -> produce unmatched CSV + reason codes by EOD; derek -> hold real replay until approvals; ana -> assess contract constraints and evidence needed; james -> patch mapping and add test; maria-finance -> prepare credit memo template if needed.
priya: ETA for CSV + initial reconciliation: EOD today. will drop results here and attach CSV link. :thumbsup:
sam: i'll draft partner message acknowledging their report, outlining our investigation steps, and noting possible outcomes (remap+replay or credit memo) pending legal/finance.
marketplace-bot: Ticket created RW-PRT-4521: 'EdgeWave retroactive entitlement reconciliation' 94 assignees: priya, derek, sam. https://tickets.redwood/RW-PRT-4521
james: after patch i'll run unit tests and a small end-to-end smoke on staging to avoid repeat regressions.
priya: update: unmatched CSV available: s3://redwood-temp/edgewave/unmatched-3276543210.csv (rows: 395). i'll start root-cause triage now.
sam: good work. let's hold on committing credits until we confirm contract eligibility and ingestion state. will update partner tomorrow with timeline.
(END)
